name: DreamFactory
description_en:
DreamFactory is a product in the API management category. Its directory profile covers Analytics, Traffic Control, Threat Protection, Developer Portal, API Lifecycle Management, API Design, Dashboard, Version Control.

Additional listed capabilities include Testing Management, Access Control. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: define interface structure and request-response contracts; bring selected indicators and records into one view; track changes to files and support revision workflows; organize test cases, execution and results; restrict information and actions according to permissions. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
DreamFactory 属于API 管理软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括数据分析、流量控制、威胁防护、开发者门户、API 生命周期管理、API 设计、仪表盘、版本控制。

资料还列出测试管理、访问控制。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持, 工作时间支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 另有定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：定义接口结构和请求响应约定；在同一视图中汇集选定指标和记录；跟踪文件变更并支持版本修订流程；组织测试用例、执行过程与结果；根据权限限制信息访问和操作。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。

research_gaps.en: Official home/pricing read; current marketing emphasizes an AI data gateway. The documentation reader rejected text/markdown as unsupported; a normal direct public HTTP request then returned 403 and no bypass was attempted. Documentation, role/connector behavior and actual license remain insufficiently established for a deep profile. Pricing claims alone do not count complete.
research_gaps.zh: 已读官方首页／定价，当前营销强调 AI 数据网关。文档阅读器不支持 text/markdown，随后普通直接公共 HTTP 请求返回 403，未绕过。文档、角色／连接器行为及实际许可证据仍不足以完成深研，仅价格不能计完成。
